Subject: Willow Labs trial — post-call recap & proposed access plan

Hi Aisha / Michael —

Thanks again for the time earlier — good discussion on the three evaluation goals and the timeline. Per our call I wanted to capture an explicit access plan so your infra team can provision quickly and our trial can start on Monday (9/7).

Summary of agreed success criteria (short):
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency under 350ms for 512-token prompts against the quantized model variant.
- Throughput: Sustained 40 reqs/min with burst to 120 reqs/min for a 1-hour window.
- Quality: win-rate >= 75% vs current in-house reranker on your 20k prompt sample (we'll run the eval harness).

Access/workflow items we need from Willow to start (please treat these as a checklist):
1) API access: either a temporary API key for your test org or instruction to create a service account we can use. Key should include model:read/generate scope. See attached provisioning doc.
2) IP allowlist: a CSV of IPs to add to your firewall (we provided a template attached). Redwood's egress IPs for the trial: 35.198.22.10, 34.72.11.204.
3) SSO invites (optional but preferred): Add priya.natarajan@redwood.ai and neha.kapoor@redwood.ai as app users in your Okta (or send SAML metadata); otherwise, we'll use API key only.
4) Sample dataset / eval set: upload a CSV of the 20k prompts to the Drive link we shared or grant view access to platform@willowlabs.com.

Proposed timeline / owners:
- 9/2 (today): share IP allowlist template + API provisioning instructions (we've attached both).
- 9/3: Willow infra confirms API key or SSO + adds Redwood IPs. (Owner: Willow platform team)
- 9/7: Trial begins (Owner: Priya / Ben)
- 9/14: Checkpoint run and quality report (Owner: Priya / Willow data team)

If you want, Ben can do a quick 'how the key works' session with your infra on Friday.

Next steps — can you confirm by end of day whether your infra will: A) create a temporary service account for Redwood, or B) prefer SSO invites? Also confirm who on your infra team will be the contact.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Priya —

Thanks for the clear write-up. This looks good and aligns with what we discussed. Quick answers:
- We'll provision a temporary service account and share keys (option A).
- I looped in our platform group (platform@willowlabs.com) — primary contact will be Ricardo Suarez (ricardo.suarez@willowlabs.com).
- We prefer API keys for the first week; once the trial stabilizes we will add SSO.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can you limit the trial key to only the model variant we'll test (so it can't be used for other models)?
- What's the expiration policy for keys you issue? We'd like a 30-day window for the temporary key.

We'll try to send the service account JSON and IP allowlist by tomorrow 9/3 EOD.
